capabilities: Extract selected text into a new note
Split the current note at the cursor line
Split a note into notes by heading level
Append extracted content to an existing note
Configure new-note location, filename prefixes and link templates
disambiguation: Not a code refactoring tool; it extracts and splits note content into new Markdown notes.
extras: Notes that split-by-headings and extraction commands can append to existing notes instead of creating new ones; settings support date placeholders like {{date:YYYYMMDDHHmm}} in folder paths and filename prefixes.
intentEvidence: Credit to MrJackphil, this plugin is based on the code snippet he created.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in commands to move selected text or content under headings into new notes with configurable naming, location and link format.

relations.evidence: Credit to MrJackphil, this plugin is based on the code snippet he created.

summary: Note refactoring tool that extracts the selected text or splits a note at the cursor or by headings into new notes, replacing the content with a link.
